title: 100 Vietnamese Food
notes: Permissive Vietnamese dish source; likely best first source for adding classes without noncommercial constraints.

title: VNFood 30 + 3 + 100 = 103
notes: Strong class coverage but noncommercial license; use only in private/noncommercial lane unless license is acceptable.

title: ViFoodVQA
notes: Recent Vietnamese food image pool; useful for class discovery and samples, not direct YOLO until labels are mapped.

title: 30VNFoods
notes: Known strong 30-class source; likely overlaps existing classes, use only for weak/missing class fill.

title: Food Recognition 2022 Dataset
notes: Best fit for real-world multi-food generalization if annotations can be converted and mapped.

title: Food Recognition 2022
notes: Larger/popular Kaggle mirror; use only if license and duplicate relationship to awsaf49 mirror are clear.

title: FoodSeg103
notes: Strong ingredient/component source; convert masks to boxes and map only visually reliable classes.

title: Nutrition Food Detection YOLO
notes: Direct YOLO format but low usage; audit quality before inclusion.

title: Fruits by YOLO - Fruits Detection
notes: Useful if fruit classes remain in V4 app target; avoid crowding dish taxonomy.

title: Nepali Food Image Labelled Dataset
notes: Cuisine mismatch; use only overlapping proteins/ingredients.

title: Junk Food Object Detection Dataset (YOLO Format)
notes: Can help fries/burger/pizza style classes if those are in product scope; not Vietnamese-focused.

title: Food Images (Food-101)
notes: Large Food-101 mirror; useful for generic dish coverage only after pseudo-box quality review.

title: ChineseFoodNet
notes: Large ChineseFoodNet mirror; potentially broad Asian dishes, but license/size and cuisine fit must be reviewed before use.

title: Padang Cuisine (Indonesian Food Image Dataset)
notes: Nearby cuisine and popular dataset; use only overlapping classes if labels and license pass.

title: FoodyDudy
notes: Potential Thai/SEA food source; format/license must be inspected before any inclusion.

title: UEC-Food256
notes: Large 256-class research reference; do not train until license is clarified.

title: Food Recognition Benchmark 2022 - AICrowd Dataset
notes: Useful reference but Kaggle license metadata is unknown.

title: Indian Food Image Dataset
notes: Reject for default training because license is not acceptable and cuisine fit is low.
